v.rationale: All three suites pass (impl-1: 26 tests, impl-2: 26, impl-3: 19), and the three share almost the same structure: enum, observer, #[Scope] scopes, form requests, and a resource. The ranking comes from authorization and the small differences between them. impl-2 authorizes inside the controller after the FormRequest has validated, so a non-author with an invalid payload gets 422 instead of the required 403 (confirmed by probe). It also adds the 'web' (session + CSRF) middleware to the JSON API, which would return 419 to real API clients, and it deleted ExampleTest. impl-1 and impl-3 both authorize with route ->can() and both passed every probe: non-ASCII title falling back to slug 'post', republishing keeping published_at, per_page as an integer, and the query filters being validated. impl-1 ranks first because it quietly deduplicates repeated tags where impl-3 rejects them with 422 via 'distinct'. impl-1 also eager-loads only the tag columns it needs, has typed factories and a more thorough suite (default page size, tag reuse). impl-3 has slightly cleaner routes and a more concise policy.
